description:
Fetch one website's full Agent-Readiness assessment by domain.

Args:
    domain: the site's domain (e.g. "example.com"). Normalized (scheme/path/case stripped).

Returns:
    domain, score (0-100 overall), level, level_label, categories[] (per-category pct with
    passed/failed/neutral check ids), checks[] (every verified check with its HTTP status
    and byte size), llms_txt_url / llms_full_txt_url, discovered_via and
    first_seen_at / checked_at / updated_at timestamps.
    Returns {error: "not_found", domain} if the domain has not been scanned.
name: portal_get_agent_surface
